Before applying this update, make sure all previously released errata
relevant to your system have been applied.

For details on how to apply this update, refer to:

https://access.redhat.com/articles/11258
portal_description:
The sos package contains a set of utilities that gather information from
system hardware, logs, and configuration files. The information can then be
used for diagnostic purposes and debugging.

This update fixes the following bug:

* Previously, the sosreport tool was collecting statistics from the /proc/timer* files by default. As a consequence, the kernel became unresponsive on busy systems. With this update, the sosreport no longer collect statistics from the /proc/timer* files by default and the kernel no longer becomes unresponsive. (BZ#1568884)

In addition, this update adds the following enhancements:

* With this update, the "ovirt-provider-ovn" plug-in has been added to collect data for integration of Red Hat Virtualization (RHV) with Open Virtual Network (OVN). (BZ#1568960)

* With this update, the "openstack_octavia" plug-in has been added. As a result, the sosreport now collects data related to OpenStack Octavia network load balancer. (BZ#1568882)

All sos users are advised to upgrade to this updated package, which fixes this bug and adds these enhancements.
